description: (Na)₂KIrF₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a KIrF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the KIrF₆ framework, K is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form KF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent IrF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All K-F bond lengths are 2.45 Å. Ir is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form IrF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent KF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ir-F bond lengths are 2.02 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one K and one Ir atom.
